description: P99 latency spike to 2.4s in payment Lambda during peak traffic, 12% failure rate on checkout endpoint
root_cause: Cold start + insufficient DB connection pooling; inadequate provisioned concurrency
resolution: Enable provisioned concurrency, increase memory to 2048MB, add RDS Proxy and implement connection pooling

description: Burst of concurrent invocations causing connection storms to downstream RDS resulting in 503 errors
root_cause: No connection pooling + RDS max_connections reached
resolution: Introduce RDS Proxy, increase max_connections, add exponential backoff and circuit breaker

description: Memory pressure and sporadic OOMs in image-processing Lambda causing retries and increased downstream queueing
root_cause: Memory leak in handler (large tensors) + no streaming processing
resolution: Refactor to stream processing, add memory limits and monitor with X-Ray

description: KV leader imbalance causing hotspots and increased read timeouts on a subset of tenants
root_cause: Skewed partitioning and timestamp oracle overload leading to leader churn
resolution: Rebalance leadership, tune placement rules and increase tso throughput

root_cause: TiKV compaction backlog from massive SST creation; LSM saturation
resolution: Throttle imports, trigger manual compaction, tune region split and schedule offline window

description: Intermittent 5xx from Bedrock chat model during high-concurrency scoring
root_cause: Model cold-start on demand + transient upstream errors not retried
resolution: Add retry with backoff, circuit breaker, and fallback cached responses

description: Titan Embeddings V2 returning 429 Too Many Requests during batch vectorization
root_cause: Exceeded RPM quota and no retry/backoff implemented
resolution: Request quota increase, implement exponential backoff with jitter, add local cache for repeated embeddings
